samples.prompt: The proposal is that employers should offer flexible hours when the work allows it. Do the advantages of this proposal outweigh its disadvantages?

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: The proposal that employers should offer flexible hours when the work allows it has both positive and negative aspects. In my view, the advantages can outweigh the disadvantages if basic practical support is included. The main benefit addresses a recurring everyday need, while at least some of the difficulties can be reduced through careful organisation.

parts.text: the advantages can outweigh the disadvantages if basic practical support is included. The main benefit addresses a recurring everyday need, while at least some of the difficulties can be reduced through careful organisation.

paragraphs.label: Thừa nhận bất lợi
paragraphs.text: A difficulty that should not be ignored is that team members may not be available at the same time. This matters because a task that needs several people can be delayed if their schedules do not overlap. For instance, a customer question may remain unanswered because the person with the information has already finished work. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.

paragraphs.label: Lợi ích lớn hơn
paragraphs.text: One important point in favour of the proposal is that employees can organise work around practical personal needs. This is possible because different starting times can reduce clashes between work and family responsibilities. For example, a parent can start earlier on two days so that they can collect a child from school. The value of this example is that the benefit is connected with a real everyday need. It is easier for people to see the purpose of an approach when they can relate it to their own situation.

It is easier for people to see the purpose of an approach when they can relate it to their own situation.

paragraphs.label: So sánh sức nặng
paragraphs.text: I give greater weight to the benefit because it could help people repeatedly, not just on one special occasion. The disadvantage is still important, but it is not always unavoidable. One response would be to give staff clear guidance and a reliable route for difficult cases. A manager could provide a simple decision guide and make sure complex complaints reach the right person. This gives a concrete reason to believe that the obstacle can be reduced rather than merely ignored.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, I believe the advantages are greater when the approach is organised responsibly. If the practical support is absent, the balance could change. The strongest case is therefore for a workable version of the proposal, not for assuming that any version will automatically succeed.
